visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A baby boy with short black hair lies on a patterned white and grey nursing pillow, wearing a tan-colored shirt with a brown and white striped collar. He holds a plastic baby bottle with both hands, drinking milk with a neutral, focused expression. The setting is a brightly lit indoor room with a plain wall in the background. (2) The scene cuts to a man with black hair, glasses, and a long blue hair extension standing in a kitchen. He is wearing a black t-shirt featuring a green mask graphic and a gold chain. He takes a drink from the baby bottle and immediately reacts with a look of extreme disgust, squinting his eyes and coughing violently while leaning forward. (3) The man continues his dramatic reaction, standing back up and gesturing with the bottle while speaking directly to the camera with highly animated facial expressions. The background shows white kitchen cabinets, a countertop with various bottles, and cleaning supplies on a shelf, lit by bright indoor ceiling lights.
